description: How the router forwards: the families it forwards, its reverse-path filter, how it spreads flows over equal-cost routes, its connection table and the interfaces that reach its node API.

conntrackMax.description: Connections the router tracks at most, `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max`; null keeps the kernel's default, which follows the memory.

ecmpHash.description: What the router hashes to pick one of several equal-cost routes for a flow, in both families: the addresses (`l3`), or the addresses, the protocol and the ports (`l4`).

ipv4.description: Whether the router forwards IPv4 packets between its interfaces.

ipv6.description: Whether the router forwards IPv6 packets between its interfaces.

interfaces.description: Interfaces, by name or glob, a glob being a prefix followed by `*`, on which the firewall accepts the node API, chalkd's TCP port 50000; null accepts it on every interface.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A delivery that keeps the management interfaces keeps a Network naming each management interface that a running Network names, in a [Match] section's Name=; a glob names every interface its prefix starts.

rpFilter.description: Reverse-path filter of the packets the router receives, in both families: `strict` drops a packet whose source the router would not route back out of the interface it came in on, `loose` one whose source it has no route to, and `off` drops none.
